rule: Model Rules for Reporting by Platform Operators with respect to Sellers in the Sharing and Gig Economy
date: approved 29 Jun 2020; optional module for sale of goods Jun 2021
what platforms must do: collect and report sellers' income to tax authorities (accommodation; transport; personal services)
source_type: secondary (OECD pages return 403 to scripts; dates from OECD front matter as quoted in search results and EY)

date: adopted 22 Mar 2021; reporting on activity from 1 Jan 2023; first reports due 31 Jan 2024
what platforms must do: report sellers' income to member-state tax authorities
source_type: secondary (EUR-Lex and Council pages block scripts)

date: issued 21 Dec 2023; in force 15 days after publication (early 2024)
what platforms must do: withhold 1% on one-half of gross remittances to sellers (0.5% effective); not collected for sellers at or below P500000 a year
source_type: news quoting the regulation (BIR PDF returns 403)

what platforms must do: platforms with a payment function withhold VAT and personal income tax for household and individual sellers; goods: VAT 1% and PIT 0.5% (residents)
designated marketplaces collect 0.5% of domestic sellers' gross turnover; individuals up to Rp500m exempt; every seller gives a tax number or NIK
